items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know where it comes from, Jeff?

ctx.x: That was his name? No, it wasn't his name.
Do you know where it comes from, Jeff? It means the life. Who was that? It means the life. It means the life. In what language? In Spanish.
Oh, I'm trying to think of this man.
